createGuildDescription: Communities group initiatives and projects. You can invite teammates after creation.
reorderHint: Drag communities to reorder them, then tap Done.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.description: You will lose access to all initiatives and projects in <bold>{{name}}</bold>. This action cannot be undone.
leave.lastAdminWarning: You are the last admin of this community. Promote another member to admin first.
leave.failedToLeave: Failed to leave community. Please try again.
leave.failedToCheckEligibility: Failed to check eligibility. Please try again.
leave.ownershipReleased: Anything you own in this community becomes unowned. A community admin can claim it later.

removeMember.title: Remove member from community
removeMember.description: Remove {{email}} from this community? They'll lose access to every initiative and project in it.
removeMember.failedToRemove: Failed to remove member. Please try again.
removeMember.ownershipReleased: Anything they own becomes unowned. You can claim it any time from the unowned content list below.

invite.title: Join {{guildName}}
invite.couldNotValidate: This invite could not be validated.
invite.alreadyHaveAccount: If you already have an account, sign in and accept the invite.
invite.accepted: Invite accepted! You now have access to this community.
invite.unableToLoad: Unable to load invite details. Please try again later.
invite.unableToAccept: Unable to accept invite right now.

settings.title: Community Settings
settings.dangerDescription: Irreversible actions for this community. Proceed with caution.
settings.deleteGuildIntro: Deleting <bold>{{name}}</bold> is permanent and cannot be undone. It will remove everything in the community, including:
settings.deleteWhatDocuments: All documents and their version history
settings.deleteWhatMembers: All community memberships and pending invites
settings.deleteConfirmDescription: Deleting <bold>{{name}}</bold> will permanently remove all initiatives, projects, tasks, documents, members, invites, and settings within it. This cannot be undone.
settings.retentionDescription: How long deleted items stay in the trash before they're permanently removed. Set to "Never" to keep them until an admin manually deletes them.
settings.discoveryDescription: A listed community appears in the directory, where anyone signed in can find it and join without an invite.
settings.discoveryCategoriesHint: Pick the subjects that describe this community. They decide which shelves it appears under.
settings.discoveryCapacityBlocked: This community has room for only one person, so nobody could join it from the directory. Ask your platform operator to raise its member limit.
settings.discoveryNotListed: Not listed. Only people with an invite can join.
settings.autoJoinPromptTitle: New members will arrive to an empty community
settings.autoJoinPromptBody: Joining this community puts nobody in an initiative, and an initiative's contents stay hidden until someone is in it. Pick where newcomers should land.
settings.autoJoinPromptEffect: The initiative you pick becomes joinable by anyone in the community, and everyone who joins the community from now on is added to it. Members already here are not added.
settings.autoJoinPromptDone: New community members will now land in {{name}}.
settings.autoJoinPromptCreateHint: To welcome people somewhere new instead, create an initiative, then turn on auto-join in its Joining settings.

artwork.title: Pictures
artwork.failed: That picture could not be saved.
artwork.tooLarge: That file is too large to work with. Try one under 12 MB.
artwork.unreadable: That image could not be read.
artwork.iconHint: Any image. It is cropped square and resized for you.
artwork.bannerHint: Any image. It is cropped to 4:1 and resized for you — around 2400 × 600 works best.
artwork.bannerColorHint: The fill shows when there is no banner image. Banner text is black or white so it stays readable on any fill, and follows the fill's best contrast until you change it.
artwork.bannerColorOnly: This community's plan doesn't include banner images. Pick a color below instead.
artwork.bannerFadeHint: A fade carries the banner past its edge and dissolves it into the page, so the tool circles and the table sit over its tail.

users.adminRequired: You need admin permissions to view this page.
users.invitesDescription: Generate links to invite new members.
users.inviteSeatsFull: All {{max}} seats are in use. Remove a member, or ask a platform admin to raise the limit, before creating another invite.
users.inviteSeatsFullPlan_one: The {{plan}} plan includes a single seat, and it's taken. Upgrade to invite people into this community.
users.inviteSeatsFullPlan_other: All {{count}} seats on the {{plan}} plan are in use. Upgrade to invite more people.
users.inviteSeatsFullUpgrade_one: Your plan includes a single seat, and it's taken. Upgrade to invite people into this community.
users.inviteSeatsFullUpgrade_other: All {{count}} seats on your plan are in use. Upgrade to invite more people.
users.removeUserDescription: This will remove {{email}} from the community. This cannot be undone.

version.newVersionOnDockerHub: A new version is available on

grantBanner.readOnly: You have temporary read-only access to {{guild}}.

billingSetup.opening: Opening billing so you can choose a plan for {{guild}}.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer ownership
transferOwnership.description: Move everything {{name}} owns in this community to another admin.
transferOwnership.claimDescription: Give everything no current member owns to an admin.
transferOwnership.adminsOnly: Only community admins can be given ownership.
transferOwnership.nothingOwned: They own nothing in this community.
transferOwnership.nothingUnowned: Everything in this community has an owner.
transferOwnership.loadFailed: Could not load what this person owns.

unownedContent.title: Unowned content
unownedContent.description: Content no current member owns — what a member leaving the community leaves behind. Claim it to put an admin back in charge.
unownedContent.empty: Everything in this community has an owner.

community.title: Communities
community.heroSubtitle: Whatever you're into, from tabletop to music to science, a community here has a seat with your name on it.
community.emptyDescription: No community here has listed itself in the directory. A community admin can list theirs from community settings.
community.noResultsDescription: No community matches “{{query}}”. Try another search or category.
community.unavailableDescription: The community directory could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
community.disabledDescription: This deployment doesn't run a community directory. A platform owner can turn one on from platform settings.

publish.title: List this community in the directory
publish.description: Anyone signed in will be able to find this community and join it without an invite.
publish.categoriesHint: These decide where the community shows up when people browse.
publish.certifyLabel: This community contains no adult content
publish.certifyIntro: By listing this community you certify that it contains none of the following:
publish.certifyMinors: Any sexual content involving a minor
publish.certifyIllegal: Illegal activity — drug use or sale, weapons, fraud, stolen goods
publish.certifyViolence: Graphic violence, gore, or encouragement of self-harm
publish.certifyDuty: You are an admin of this community, so this is yours to enforce. You are expected to watch for this content and remove it. A community that stops meeting this is removed from the directory.

community.ageGateBody: Anyone signed in can find the communities here, so joining one asks your age once. You will not be asked again.

nameDisplay.title: How members are named
nameDisplay.description: Whether this community shows people's real names, or the usernames they chose.
nameDisplay.toggleHint: Off, members appear by username. On, their full name is shown where they have entered one.
